analysis_status: Exploratory; specified after original 35-model external outcomes and 75-fit internal OOF outcomes were known. New CV75 external predictions have not been generated.

inference.age_stats: Each checkpoint uses its own inner-training config statistics; never refitted on external data
inference.deterministic_input_cache: Optional in-memory float32 image tensor cache, computed using the unchanged archived evaluation transform; checked against original dataset tensors

bacc_aggregation.internal: Existing pooled OOF per seed is retained exactly.
bacc_aggregation.external: Average model correctness across folds using w[f,c]=original internal outer-fold support for class c / full internal support for class c. Then average recalls equally over six classes and average the five seeds.
bacc_aggregation.equal_fold_sensitivity: Also report the unweighted mean of the five fold-specific metrics per seed for each cohort, without replacing pooled OOF.

probability_metrics_aggregation: For NLL and Brier, external per-model losses are averaged using original fold image counts / 2298; internal pooled losses retained. Per-fold model metrics also retained.
cross_cohort_effect: External minus internal difference in the paired BACC contrast for the same fixed fitted model collection. Association only; not causal domain shift.

bootstrap.unit: patient cluster separately within each cohort
bootstrap.pairing: Identical sampled patients for all arms, seeds and folds within cohort; two cohorts sampled independently.
bootstrap.fixed: All fitted weights, fold identities, initialization seeds and original aggregation weights are fixed, not independent replicate patients.
bootstrap.rare_missing_class_draw: Reject and redraw if any of six classes has zero sampled support; report rejected draw count.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Descriptive unadjusted intervals; not confirmatory or full-retraining uncertainty

required_outputs: All 75 external prediction CSVs and checkpoint hashes
All per-fold/per-seed internal and external metrics
15 seed-level cohort summaries and paired comparisons
Patient-cluster intervals for each cohort and external-minus-internal contrasts
SEK-to-MEL rates, NLL and Brier summaries
interpretation_limits: Same previously examined external cohort; no new independent institution
Internal PAD historical architecture-development exposure remains
Case mix, acquisition and reference standards differ; no causal domain-shift interpretation
No model, seed, checkpoint, threshold, training recipe or subset will be selected using these outcomes
